capabilities: Visualize and navigate between daily notes in a calendar view
Display the spendings frontmatter value of each daily note
Customize the spendings field in the settings panel
disambiguation: Not a full accounting tool; it only shows one spendings value per daily note in a calendar view.
extras: The manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice; the README is brief and shows the spending workflow only through a short example.
intentEvidence: creates a simple Calendar view for visualizing and navigating between your daily notes forked from liamcain
problem: The standard calendar view of daily notes cannot show custom numeric data such as daily spending amounts.

relations.evidence: Use Dataview to auto-calculate all SPENDINGS in current file

summary: Calendar view for daily notes that displays a spendings value from each note's frontmatter.
